purpose: Consolidate TI-409, TI-410 and TI-411 into one decision-time row-version identity that binds exact raw fields, source clocks, session/completion semantics, transform ancestry and immutable parent generation.

ownershipBoundary.D03: Consumes and validates the receipt before technical-indicator inference.
ownershipBoundary.sharedSourceContinuityOwner: Must create the raw payload/version, session and corporate-action evidence and independently attest it.
ownershipBoundary.prohibition: The D03 adapter cannot self-issue SOURCE_OWNER_VERIFIED or PROVIDER_SIGNED authority. A syntactically valid receipt does not prove external authenticity.

rawBinding: provider row version and publication/first-known/capture clocks

requiredDecisionChecks: recomputed raw digest equals stored rawVersionDigest
transform sourceRawVersionDigest equals recomputed raw digest
recomputed transformed digest equals stored transformedRowVersionDigest
bar interval end is not after decision cutoff
provider first-known and local capture are not after decision cutoff
independent source authority is PROVIDER_SIGNED or SOURCE_OWNER_VERIFIED
source attestation digest equals recomputed raw digest

stateSemantics.ELIGIBLE: All internal integrity, PIT, session, completion, parent and independent-attestation checks pass.
stateSemantics.BLOCKED: Positive contradiction or integrity mismatch exists; do not compute/join indicator evidence from this row version.
stateSemantics.UNKNOWN: Required independent fact is absent or unauthenticated; never coerce to zero/BAD and never count as eligible.

falsifiers.case: raw high bytes change while stored digest is retained
legitimate v2 correction is first-known/captured after the earlier decision
falsifiers.expected: BLOCKED for earlier decision; ELIGIBLE for later decision when separately committed

falsifiers.case: full daily bar interval ends after an intraday decision
adapter/local-capture string is the only authority
transform ancestry, parent generation or committed row digest differs

counterargumentsAndLimits: A hardcoded 13:30 completion time is insufficient because an individual security can have a delayed close to 13:33 and source publication can occur later.
A later correction is not bad data. It is a new immutable version that is ineligible for an earlier decision and may be eligible for a later one.
PARTIAL intraday bars are not prohibited, but they require a distinct formula/timeframe contract and cannot silently satisfy COMPLETE daily semantics.
Whole-file HTTP ETag/Last-Modified can help raw capture replay but does not by itself prove row-level version identity, first-known time or correction lineage.
Passing isolated synthetic QA does not establish provider coverage, false-rejection rate, alpha, OOS performance, costs or fill feasibility.
exactNextContinuationPoint: Ask the shared source/continuity owner to map real TWSE/TPEx/Fugle rows into this receipt without self-attestation. Run outcome-blind multi-date captures across both markets and source contracts, recording source date, HTTP/file version evidence, complete/partial/corrected/UNKNOWN counts, symbol-session certification, legitimate correction false blocks, immutable parent-child keyset reconciliation and non-secret cost/latency. No TI-005/TI-006 outcome test or Class-B runtime wiring until those gates pass.
